mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates on future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equities, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or the average return in such periods is not statistically positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.8% over a 3-month window signals weakening labor market conditions, which increases the probability of central bank rate cuts, thereby boosting equity valuations through lower discount rates and higher risk appetite over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE exceeds 5.8% for 3 months, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts below 1.5 million units over two consecutive months signals a contraction in residential investment, which reduces demand for construction materials and consumer durables, leading to lower corporate revenues and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when HOUST falls below 1500.0 for 2 months, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below 100.0 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which signals weakening economic activity and reduced corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO remains below 100.0 for 2 months, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signal a broad-based demand contraction, which increases the likelihood of a recession and triggers risk-off behavior, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < 1500.0 and RSAFS < 620000.0 for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS fall below thresholds for 2 months, or the joint signal fails to outperform a single-series model in walk-forward IC tests.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% combined with a sustained increase in CPI inflation above 3.0% signals a tightening monetary policy regime, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of periods when both FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0% for 3 months, or the interaction signal shows no significant predictive power (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment (UNRATE) above 5.8% and a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 145,000 for two consecutive months signals a labor market deterioration, which increases the probability of a recession and triggers risk-off sentiment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 5.8% and PAYEMS < 145000.0 for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both UNRATE > 5.8% and PAYEMS < 145000.0 for 2 months, or the joint signal fails to outperform individual series in walk-forward tests.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) below 620,000 million dollars combined with a drop in GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.0% annualized signals a weakening consumer-driven economy, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS < 620000.0 and GDPC1 < 1.0% (annualized) for 2 consecutive quarters
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances when both RSAFS < 620000.0 and GDPC1 < 1.0% (annualized) for 2 quarters, or the interaction signal shows no predictive power (Rank IC < 0.03).
